property.name: Greens Storage Escondido
property.address: 25260 N Centre City Pkwy, Escondido, CA 92026

buildings.name: Building A
buildings.note: Five RV garages with power at the east end of the office building, doors onto the gate aisle: A001 (15x40) next to the hall, then A002-A005 (15x45). The 2023 permit-era site map shows the 15x40 bay at the far end; the 2024 customer map and Cubby put A001 (15x40) next to the hall - the 2024 map is followed.

buildings.name: Office
buildings.note: Office, conference room and restrooms at the gate. The 77 rental mailboxes (M100-M176) are drawn along the lobby wall; their exact position inside the office is not on the plans.

buildings.name: Hall (Z001)
buildings.note: Hall between the office and the A garages, labeled "Building A" on the 2023 site map (about 66 x 47 ft). Holds the 60x45 space Z001 - matched by size, the plans do not number it.

buildings.name: Building B
buildings.note: Building along the parkway: drive-up B003-B022 (10x20) and B023 / B024 (RV size) open onto the gate aisle, B001 at the east end; climate-controlled B025-B084 off the inner hallway. BC1 / BC2 (no size, not on any plan) are parked in the B-101 / B-102 utility rooms.

buildings.name: Building C
buildings.note: Main climate-controlled building under the solar roof, two stories (site map: "Building C first floor" and "second floor"). Level 1: drive-up C001-C044 on the north wall and the 10x10 drive-ups on the south wall, interior C046-C274 off two hallways; level 2: C300-C563. The southeast corner is cut at 45 degrees.

buildings.name: Building D
buildings.note: South of Building C: drive-up D001-D019 (10x20) facing C, climate-controlled D020-D057 off the hallway behind them.

buildings.name: Building E
buildings.note: Long building at the southwest edge: seventeen 15x40 vehicle garages (E002-E018) facing the aisle, E001 (10x20) and E019 / E020 (10x10) at the east end.

buildings.name: Building F
buildings.note: Six 15x44 powered RV garages (F001-F006) in one row, doors facing Building E. One level - all six fit the footprint.

units.note: Tenant releasing owner's interest to Triskell Restorations
